Joseph Banerjee | joseph.banerjee229@example.com | +91 9158608319
Gurugram, Haryana

Professional Summary
Senior QA Automation Engineer with extensive experience in designing and implementing automated test frameworks and CI integrations. Proven track record of improving test coverage, reducing regression cycles, and partnering with engineering to deliver reliable web and API products. Notice period: 90 days.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Test Automation, TestNG, JUnit, Confluence, Linux, Jira

Work Experience
Senior QA Automation Engineer, UrbanPantry (Sep 2021 - Present)
- Designed and maintained a Selenium-based automation framework for core web ordering flows, integrating TestNG for test orchestration and reporting, resulting in a 40% reduction in manual regression time.
- Implemented JUnit-style unit checks within automation suites to validate utility modules and shared libraries, enabling faster pinpointing of defects during nightly runs.
- Collaborated with engineering and product teams via Confluence and Jira to define acceptance criteria and track automation coverage; automated critical API and UI tests that prevented multiple high-severity production incidents.
- Set up Linux-based CI pipelines to execute parallel TestNG suites on merge, cutting average release verification from 12 hours to under 3 hours.

SDET, Infosys (May 2019 - Aug 2021)
- Built and enhanced Selenium frameworks for enterprise client portals, incorporating Test Automation best practices and TestNG for data-driven test execution across environments.
- Developed JUnit test harnesses for backend service validation and integrated them into end-to-end Test Automation workflows to improve reliability of nightly builds.
- Authored and maintained Confluence documentation and test plans, and managed defect lifecycles in Jira to streamline collaboration between QA and development teams.
- Tuned Linux-based test runners and parallel execution strategies to reduce test suite runtime by over 30% while maintaining stable Selenium sessions.

Education
CA, ICAI
